summary: Patch 6328380a3a83713ff6f55eec772358aadd2f9014 in ruby (lib/time.rb) modifies Time.xmlschema to strip leading/trailing whitespace via time.strip before parsing. PCA analysis confirmed 1 INPUT_CONTRACT_CHANGE finding (HIGH priority). Directed testing on before/after builds confirmed: 3/4 contract breaches (whitespace inputs: BEFORE rejects with ArgumentError, AFTER correctly parses), 1/4 contract passed (no-whitespace control). All 7 directed test assertions pass on patched build. 100% patch line coverage (1/1 executable line). Conclusion: incompatible change - input contract relaxed; previously-rejected whitespace-padded strings now silently accepted. Worktrees cleaned.
